claim_summary: A connected nonsingular six-site 0/1 determinant-weighted hole instance has a real-stable signed ambient-hole polynomial, while coefficientwise squaring its nonnegative coefficients destroys stability: exact Rayleigh difference -12 and an exact upper-half-plane zero.
scope: Refutes coefficient-square stability closure and any stable homogenized/polarized lift that specializes back to that coefficient-square polynomial; does not refute the valid fixed-k dummy padding identity or solve microscopic sampling/energy comparison.
next_decisive_gate: Construct a microscopic two-replica kernel with computable transitions and prove polynomial integrated Dirichlet-energy comparison along annealing without coefficient-square stability or unknown hole-partition oracles.
